assets.label: 話しかけている赤い服の女の子
assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated waist-up character asset on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, matching these existing warm watercolor/gouache Japanese children's-book illustrations. Soft brown linework, paper-like paint texture only within the character, natural child proportions, brown expressive eyes. Match the existing cutouts in scale and square canvas, full head/hair and hands visible, only an intentional waist/hip-level crop at bottom. No background, colored flecks, ground shadow, speech bubble, text, symbols or extra characters. Clean alpha-transparent gaps. Image 1 is the POSE/ROLE reference, the blue boy speaking to a listener on SCREEN RIGHT. Image 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Replace the boy with the SAME chestnut bob-haired GIRL from image 2: yellow star hairclip, coral-red button cardigan, cream shirt and teal pleated skirt. She faces RIGHT in three-quarter/near-profile conversation, eyes looking RIGHT directly toward a separately placed listener, warm engaged smile with mouth OPEN while speaking, one complete open palm raised toward the listener just like the boy. Use the girl's own face/hair/outfit, no hoodie or boy features. Make her clearly talking TO a nearby person rather than looking out toward the viewer. Girl only.
